payload.note: Exact mixed-Hessian-square method obstruction: on every L^4 torus with L>=8 divisible by four, the positive axial background Omega=(1,2,3,4) gives Hess S[h_o,sin(p_L x_1)]=19 sin(p_L)+(9/16) sin(2p_L)=(161/8)p_L+O(p_L^3) at the displayed fiber point. Positivity and analyticity of the one-site conditional density make its squared expectation order p_L^2, so no background-uniform pointwise bound by C omega(p_L)^2=O(p_L^4) exists. This retires the local-Poincare-then-Cauchy route before signed cancellation, but does not obstruct the signed covariance, block/annealed response, global Poincare/Witten, or interacting H^-1 gates. The next gate is the translation-averaged signed response symbol or a block conditional response.
